steps: Per frame: with Pillow find the right-edge histogram rows, the widest row and the visible price range from the axis labels; record pixel boxes.
Fraction f_drawn = (widest-row price - visible low) / (visible high - low). f_computed = same from the PROFILE_PARITY_T1/T2 computed profile over the same price span.
PASS = both frames within one histogram row height; else FAIL; unreadable = NOT_IN_DATA. Append the result and the verdict to PROFILE_PARITY.md.
